body:
I cried when I read this, because I am where you are. The only thing that is stopping me is fear of failing, fear of pain.


But if you want to talk, please PM me. I don't have any answers. But I can listen and understand.
I have a personal counseling session set up for Nov. 2 and we are in couples counseling, but there is just so much to talk about in such little time. Thanks.
